description_en: Queries the associations of a policy route table
description_zh: 查询策略路由表关联关系
name: DescribeTransitRouterPolicyTableAssociations

fields.help_en:
The filter condition. Valid values:

PolicyTableId: The instance ID of the policy routing table.
AttachmentId: The instance ID of the network connectivity instance.
AssociationId: The instance ID of the policy routing table associate relationship.

By default, multiple filter conditions are connected by the AND operator. A match is found only when all filter conditions are met.

You can specify up to five filter conditions at a time
fields.help_zh:
过滤条件。取值：

PolicyTableId：策略路由表ID。
AttachmentId：网络连接实例ID。
AssociationId：策略路由表关联关系实例ID。

多个过滤条件之间默认是与的关系，即必须符合所有过滤条件，才视为匹配过滤条件。

一次最多支持输入5个过滤条件
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the filter condition.

Specify the filter value based on Key. You can specify multiple filter values for a single Key. Multiple filter values are connected by the OR operator. A match is found when any of the filter values is met.

You can specify up to five filter values for a single filter condition
fields.help_zh:
过滤条件的值。

根据Key指定过滤值。一个Key支持指定多个过滤值，多个过滤值之间是或的关系，即只要符合其中一个过滤值，则视为匹配该过滤条件。

一个过滤条件最多支持输入5个过滤值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The information about filter conditions. 

You can specify up to five filter conditions at a time
parameters.help_zh:
过滤条件的信息。

一次最多支持输入5个过滤条件
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en:
The token for the next query. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, it indicates that no next query is available.
If NextToken returns a value, the value is the token for the next query
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return per page in a paginated query. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: max_results

Associations.description_en: The associate relationships between the policy routing table and network connectivity instances
Associations.description_zh: 策略路由表与网络连接实例的关联关系

AssociationId.description_en: The ID of the association between the policy route table and the network instance connection
AssociationId.description_zh: 策略路由表与网络实例连接的关联ID

AttachmentId.description_en: The ID of the network instance connection

PolicyTableId.description_en: The instance ID of the policy routing table

Status.description_en:
The status of the association. Valid values:

Active: Active.
Associating: Associating.
Dissociating: Dissociating
Status.description_zh:
关联关系的状态。

Active：可用。
Associating：加载中。
Dissociating：卸载中

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries returned per page in a paginated query
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时，每次显示的条目数

NextToken.description_en: The token for the next query in a paginated query
NextToken.description_zh: 分批次查询时，下一次查询的Token
